title: iPermit Jurisdiction Record
description: Canonical data shape of a single jurisdiction record. See docs/specs/jurisdiction-naming.md (T00-08). The jurisdiction_level enum is aligned with rule-object.schema.json so rule_object.jurisdiction_id can reference a jurisdiction_record.jurisdiction_id directly.

jurisdiction_id.description: Permanent, opaque kebab-case slug. Hierarchical and self-describing. Never reused once issued. Grammar defined in jurisdiction-naming.md §3.

canonical_name.description: Full official name. No abbreviations. Title Case. UTF-8. Diacritics preserved as-is. Apostrophes use U+2019 RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK.

parent_jurisdiction_id.description: ID of the immediate parent per the AGENTS.md jurisdiction hierarchy. Null only for federal jurisdictions. Multi-parent jurisdictions are not allowed — split into separate records.

aliases.description: Alternate names observed in source documents. Each alias must declare its type so analysts can weigh matches during ingest (T02-06).

value.description: The alternate string itself, as it appears in the source.

alias_type.description: Why this alias exists. Historical aliases SHOULD set date_from/date_to. Misspellings record observed errors so ingest can normalize them.

source.description: Where the alias was observed (URL, statute reference, intake form, etc.).

date_from.description: First date this alias was in use. Required pattern for historical aliases.

date_to.description: Last date this alias was in use. Null/absent means still current.

notes.description: Free-text analyst note (e.g. context of a misspelling).

fips.description: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS identifiers. Required for federal, state, county. Optional for sub-county.

fips_state.description: Two-digit FIPS state code. Texas is '48'.

fips_county.description: Five-digit FIPS county code (state + county). Travis County, TX is '48453'.

fips_place.description: Seven-digit FIPS place code (state + place). Optional, used for municipalities.

geometry_ref.description: Opaque pointer to a geometry record in the GIS store. Full GIS schema is T05-01's concern. String-only — no inline geometry.

active_from.description: Date this jurisdiction came into legal existence (incorporation, county formation, district creation). For pre-1900 jurisdictions an analyst-attested approximate date is acceptable.

active_to.description: Date this jurisdiction ceased to exist (dissolution, merger, split). Null means currently active.

replaced_by.description: Jurisdiction IDs that replace this record after dissolution/merger/split. Set together with active_to. See jurisdiction-naming.md §8.

replaced_from.description: Jurisdiction IDs this record was carved or merged from. Set when this record is the result of a split or merger.

notes.description: Free-text analyst notes. Not consumed by the rules engine.

allOf.description: Federal jurisdictions have no parent; all others must have one.
FIPS is required for federal, state, and county jurisdictions.
County jurisdictions must carry both state and county FIPS.
State jurisdictions must carry state FIPS.
